description:
Extend `AgentTree` to be the one process-local fleet registry for both spawn and orchestrated children.

## Background

We are not creating a second worker registry in beadwork. Tree already has id, name, agent, task, status, usage, parent/child. Add group, role, taskType, description, domain, and a kind: `spawn` vs `orchestrated`.

## Files

- `packages/pi-minions/src/tree.ts`
- `packages/pi-minions/src/types.ts` AgentNode only if the types issue did not already add optional fields

## Technical approach

- Orchestrated fleet snapshots: `kind === "orchestrated"` AND not terminal AND in the group.
- Spawn nodes never appear in those snapshots even if still running.
- description is stored as provided; do not infer from task.
- domain is opaque JSON-ish fields, not parsed ticket semantics. Optional live duplicate convenience (same workItemId still live in this process) can live here or on the orchestrate issue; if here, it is string equality, not ticket ownership.

## Success criteria

- Existing spawn tests still pass with default kind `spawn`.
- Snapshot helper returns only live orchestrated members of one group.

## Test plan

- Unit: add spawn node + orchestrated node; snapshot excludes spawn.
- Unit: terminal orchestrated nodes excluded from "still running".
- Unit: metadata round-trip (role, taskType, description, domain).

## Considerations

Do not add session handles to the tree if that couples UI to runtime; handles stay in SubsessionManager. Tree is inspectable state. list_minions/show_minion will read this later.
title: Extend AgentTree with group, role, taskType, and spawn vs orchestrated kind
